share.intro: Bring your batch in, show what you have achieved, and keep your family in the loop. Nothing is shared until you choose it.

batch.title: Invite your batch
batch.notHere: {{n}} of your batch aren’t here yet
batch.notHereNone: Everyone from your batch on the college’s list is here.
batch.off: Your college has not turned on invites from members yet.
batch.left: You can send {{n}} more this week.
batch.noneLeft: You have sent this week’s invites. More next week.
batch.how: They get the college’s invite on WhatsApp, with a link that signs them in. We never show you their numbers.
batch.skipped: Nobody new to invite right now.

pages.title: Public pages
pages.intro: A page with a link you can post anywhere: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, your résumé. It shows only what you see here. You can take it down at any time.
pages.minor: Public pages are for members over 18.
pages.none: Nothing to share yet. A verified offer, a finished roadmap or mentoring juniors each make a page you can publish.
pages.takenDown: Page taken down. The link no longer works.
pages.dialogBody: Anyone with the link can see it. It never shows your phone, email, exact salary or anything else from your profile.
pages.indexableBody: Off: only people with the link find it.

parent.title: Monthly update for a parent
parent.intro: Once a month, on WhatsApp: the drives you registered for, sessions you attended and your readiness score. Your parent confirms with a code first.
parent.gradesBody: Off unless you turn it on.
parent.codeTitle: Enter the code your parent received
parent.codeBody: We sent a 6-digit code to the number ending {{last4}}. Ask them for it.
parent.active: Sent each month to the number ending {{last4}}, in {{lang}}.
parent.stopped: Updates stopped. We deleted the number.
parent.confirmed: Confirmed. The first update goes out at the start of next month.

captain.intro: Help your class join. You see counts for your own class only, never names or numbers.
captain.noneLeft: You have sent today’s invites. More tomorrow.
captain.allIn: Everyone on the list for your class has an invite.
captain.off: Your college has not turned on member invites yet.

referral.saved: Thanks. It helps the alumni who refer.
referral.impactNote: From what students told us after you referred them.

admin.intro: Let members bring their batch in, and publish your college’s placement outcomes as a public page.
admin.invitesBody: Alumni invite their own batch, and Campus Captains their class, on WhatsApp from your college’s list. They never see the numbers. Each member can send {{n}} a week.
admin.attest: Everyone on our list agreed to hear from the college on WhatsApp.
admin.outcomesBody: Placement percentage by year, top recruiters, where alumni work and mentoring hours. Aggregates only; counts under 5 show as “<5”. No names.
